places.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Lunaway contributors, Atout France (positions: Base Adresse Nationale, IGN BD TOPO)
places.name: Lunaway places

vector_layers.description: Every live place, one point each, from the pin zoom on

fields.city: String, from zoom 12: the town of the address, else of the commune; absent when neither is known
fields.h: Number: the maximum vehicle height in centimetres, rounded; absent when unknown
fields.id: String: the place's id, for Query.place
fields.kind: String: the PlaceKind code (motorhome_area, service_area, campsite, parking, nature, rest_area, picnic_area, farm, homestay, off_road, extra_service)
fields.name: String, from zoom 12; absent when the place has none
fields.night: String: the OvernightStatus code (allowed, tolerated, day_only, forbidden, unknown)
fields.price: Number: 0 when parking is free, 1 when it is paid; absent when unknown, which is not free
fields.s: Number: the services, bit i set for the i-th Service of the domain (drinking_water 0, grey_water 1, black_water 2, waste_bin 3, toilets 4, showers 5, electricity 6, wifi 7, laundry 8, lpg 9, gas_bottles 10, vehicle_wash 11, bakery 12, swimming_pool 13, pets_allowed 14, mobile_data 15, winter_caravanning 16)

vector_layers.description: Every live place as a dot, below the pin zoom: one MultiPoint per set of properties, one point per pixel of a 512 px tile holding such a place

fields.s: Number: as in places, bits 0 to 8 only (drinking_water to laundry)

poi.attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, Lunaway contributors, La Poste, Ministère de l'Économie (prix des carburants), FINESS
poi.name: Lunaway points of interest

vector_layers.description: Every point, from the point zoom on

fields.alwaysOpen: Boolean, present and true for a point open day and night
fields.category: String: groceries, vending, water, fuel, health, services
fields.hours: String: <first opening, minutes since 1970>:<open>,<closed>,<open>,... in minutes; empty when closed over the whole window
fields.hoursUntil: Number: minutes since 1970 at which the known hours end
fields.id: String: the point's id, for Query.poi
fields.lpg: Boolean, present and true for a fuel station that sells LPG
fields.maybeClosed: Boolean, present and true when FINESS lists the establishment as closed
fields.name: String, absent when the source gives none

vector_layers.description: Points counted per category and grid cell, below the point zoom

fields.count: Number of points in the cell

vector_layers.description: Food vending machines counted per kind and grid cell, below the point zoom; poi_clusters counts them too

fields.count: Number of machines of that kind in the cell
fields.kind: String: vending_pizza, vending_bread, vending_farm_products, vending_eggs_milk, vending_ice
